page: Microsoft Azure DC64ads_cc_v5 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the DCADCCV5 family, powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor. It features 64 vCPUs mapped to 32 physical cores with 2.0 threads per core, operating at a clock speed of 3.525 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The server is configured with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It includes 2458 GB of local storage and is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieves top 25% results in stress-ng multi-core CPU performance, PassMark CPU score, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory performance is notable, with PassMark memory score ranking in the top 10% and small-block read-only memory bandwidth in the top 25%. However, large-block read and write memory bandwidths fall into the middle 50% range.

This hardware profile is suited for database operations, as evidenced by top 25% scores in PassMark database operations and Redis SET operations. It also handles image processing and ray tracing efficiently, scoring in the top 25% for both. For language model tasks, the server performs adequately on smaller models, but text generation on large 70B models is a notable bottleneck, falling into the bottom 25% of benchmarked systems. The resource density of 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256 GB RAM paired with local storage offers a balanced cost-to-resource ratio for enterprise database and multi-threaded compute workloads.
